verdict.rationale: Superhuman's what's-new page says users can build agents via chat or a visual builder that 'run proactively based on triggers you set,' and the MCP lets external AI tools drive workflows across inbox and calendar. Nothing confirms that time-based or recurring schedules are among those triggers; the one timing-related feature is send-at-optimal-time follow-ups, which are one-off sends, not recurring jobs. missing for 10: explicit recurring/time-based scheduling (e.g., daily/weekly cron-style runs), documentation of trigger types and agent builder depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
